Curriculum vitae

Daniel Bryars

Engineer and founder, 29 years. I co-founded a secure B2B SaaS company, was its CTO through scaling to 40 staff and £8M ARR, and sold it. Before that, Formula One R&D and motorsport electronics. Since then, an MSc in AI with Distinction and a move into robotics.

Different industries, one job: systems that have to work in the physical world, and the question that follows them everywhere — how do we know this is really working?

Current focus

AI and robot learning

Completed an MSc in Artificial Intelligence with Distinction, focused on robot learning. Built a MuJoCo robot-arm simulation, connected it to a 3D headset via OpenVR, collected teleoperation data, trained PyTorch policies, tracked experiments, managed checkpoints on Hugging Face, and tested policies on physical hardware.

  • Research manuscript being reworked for ICRA 2027.
  • Practical interest in evaluation: task success, reality gaps, resets, calibration, data quality and failure modes.
  • Recent stack includes Python, PyTorch, LeRobot, ACT/ACT-ViT, MuJoCo, W&B and Hugging Face Hub.

Commercial proof

Founder to exit

Co-founded Aeriandi and helped scale it into a B2B SaaS business with 40 staff and £8M ARR. Stayed hands-on as CTO and chief architect through product, platform, hiring, customer trust, compliance, reliability and acquisition.

Physical systems

Motorsport and F1

Started in motorsport electronics: embedded C, engine controllers, sensors, wiring looms, CAN/serial integration, telemetry and high-pressure trackside debugging. Later worked in Formula One R&D on sensors, actuators, software, hardware and automated systems.

Engineering instincts

Reliability and debugging

  • Formal FMEA, explicit failure limits, incident response and operational learning.
  • Cross-layer debugging: from an application symptom down to a network trace, a platform behaviour or a scope on a wire.
  • Production operations at scale, across cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

Leadership

Teams and strategy

  • Hired, built and led engineering teams from two people to forty.
  • Owned technical strategy through a merger and two acquisitions.
  • Happiest as a hands-on senior IC who can also lead, rather than a manager who used to build.

Compliance

Regulated systems
